rv.q: The zany show-within-a-show is written by Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer and Henry Shields (“The Play That Goes Wrong”) and follows the Cornley University Drama Society.
The problem with Peter Pan Goes Wrong is that we see every joke coming from a mile away, sapping it of all its humor before it arrives.

cn.t: Critics are split: one finds the production ironically lives up to its title in unintended ways, while another calls it "wildly fun" with genuine laughs. A mixed reception, though physical comedy and audience energy draw praise.
